description_short: Project the attack paths a named threat actor would plausibly take through a specific application flow map.
description_long: Use when an analyst names a threat actor (group, campaign, or malware family) and wants to know how that actor would move through a specific application or estate. Resolves the actor against MITRE ATT&CK to build a closed set of techniques the actor is documented to use, normalizes a flow map of the application into components, zones, trust boundaries and data flows, and reports which components form the reachable entry surface and which routes reach the crown jewels. Actions: profile_actor (what ATT&CK documents an actor doing, no LLM); validate_flow_map (lint a flow map and rank its entry surface and crown-jewel routes, no LLM). Path projection itself is not yet implemented.
